name: OpenBao / Vault secrets
description: Optional. Installs the OpenBao CLI and 'secrets-gh-login', which logs gh in with a GitHub token read from an OpenBao/Vault server you configure via environment variables. Sign-in is OpenBao's OIDC login in the browser; no long-lived token is kept. Nothing is configured by default.

version.description: OpenBao release to install (without the leading 'v').
